title: Brother Sam's drums as his model
summary: He followed his brother Sam's style and used Sam's drums until he bought his own.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: My brother was a drummer way before my time, you know, and I come right behind him. That was way back in 1919 and 1920. He played with different bands around here like Lewis, you know, and Kid René and all of them. And I just took the style behind him, pick it up behind him. He gave it up in the late 20s. Sam, he gave it up, yeah.
Did you ever try to play on his drums when you were in the middle?

I played a while on his drums because I didn't have any drums during them days. I used to use his drums like around the house and sometimes little small parties, you know, with a piano and drums. He told me when he wouldn't be using them. I'd use them sometimes. And like I said, I sent off to a music publisher in the house in the Willis and Music people and bought my first snare drum. And I bought my bass drum local.
